{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to fight for a strong health care workforce with an emphasis on primary care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats remain committed to eliminating disparities in health.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to make sure families have access to mental health and substance abuse services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strengthen Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats oppose efforts to block grant Medicaid, slash its funding, and leave millions more without health insurance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to invest in the nation's public health infrastructure to ensure the ability to respond to emergencies and support community-based efforts to prevent disease.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to support Community Health Centers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats have increased overall funding to combat HIV/AIDS to record levels and will continue this effort.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama established the first-ever comprehensive National HIV/AIDS Strategy for responding to the domestic epidemic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National HIV/AIDS Strategy calls for reducing HIV incidence, increasing access to care, optimizing health outcomes, and reducing HIV-related health disparities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The National HIV/AIDS Strategy is an evidence-based plan guided by science and seeks to direct resources to communities at greatest risk, including gay men, black and Latino Americans, substance users, and others at high risk of infection.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to support America's groundbreaking biomedical researchers in their lifesaving work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
